preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A1 <= 10**9 and 0 <= D <= 10**9 and 1 <= L <= R <= 10**18 for A1, D, L, R in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A1 is between 1 and 10^9, D is between 0 and 10^9, and 1 <= L <= R <= 10^18.
The number of parsed test cases matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == sum(F(A1 + k * D) for k in range(L - 1, R)) for i, (A1, D, L, R) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output line i contains the sum of F(A_k) for k from L to R, where A_k = A1 + (k-1)*D and F(X) is the recursive sum of digits until a single digit is reached.
